cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Dad, I've accepted the museum job. Can you be pleased I'm leaving the workshop?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're thirty. You don't need me to release you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I need the person who taught me to make things to think this counts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pack your tools. You might want to come back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you sharpen them for the museum instead? Send me off expecting me to do well.

mechanism: A professionally corrects permission and tool preparation while seeking Dad emotional endorsement of an already accepted museum job.
confusable: D73 asks attendance as connection proof; D76 needs approval from a valued person even though their permission is unnecessary.
comparison: Lease alternative asks mother to include partner in celebration; museum alternative turns tools prepared for retreat into tools prepared for success.
seedUse: Dad, accepted museum job, workshop, packed tools and sharpening derive from D76-a; S03 adds precise storage-versus-working preparation correction.
